comment: Class lectures are boring and unhelpful. Grades project worth half your grade based on if she likes you, takes weeks to return grades, exams are much harder than they should be. Other marketing professors make it easy (which it should be, its marketing) so don't take her unless you have to. you will end up doing much more work
accused someone of kahoot-bombing because of how they look

She is an amazing professor. You will have to work for your grade, but the midterm is easy if you study for it. The group project is difficult, but you will learn a lot. She is always available to assist you, and is so kind/motherly. Take her course!

I came in expecting an easy marketing class and had a big learning curve. Cares about the material and explains concepts well. Several reading quizzes, and the midterm is trickier than you would think. Make sure to stay on top of the group project or your grade will suffer! I'd recommend trying to get this class with a different professor first.
I've never given anyone else a review in my 4 years here so that should tell you something. Unclear grader, gives projects with no guidelines. Stay away from this class.
Nicest professor at UR! Participate in class and do the work and your guaranteed an A. Always available to talk.
She is very smart and knows everything about digital marketing. Interesting assignments and lectures. Drops lowest quiz grade.
Dr. Sadeghein is so knowledgable and passionate about marketing. Lectures are very engaging. The projects and assignments have real-life marketing implications.

Professor Sadeghein's upbeat attitude and organized course plan made handling a class during the pandemic a much more positive experience. She posts announcements every week with to-do lists which makes it easy to stay on top of things. She is available outside class, and very caring.

Supposed to be a fun class but it wasnt at all. Nice professor but terrible teacher. Memorize the exact wording of all powerpoints for tests. If one word is off youll get no credit. Little direction on homework / projects and when asked to explain why you got points off on anything (so you can improve next time) she cant explain any of it.

This teacher assigns work with little to no explanation of what is to be expected of you. Directions and the flow of the course are always vague. Meanwhile, the grading is incredibly harsh (loss of points for the background color of a powerpoint) and at some points flat right unfair. Do not take this teacher.

Be prepared to memorize everything on the PowerPoints and from the textbook. Picky about detail on tests and the entire class is cumulative. No clear directions on the group project that is a quarter of the grade.
A great teacher that is enthusiastic about marketing.
nice prof, but you need to literally memorize the entire textbook for the exams

Test heavy. Knowing ppts & lectures will not help you on test, grading is harsh and unfair. Professor: encourages concise answers but takes off many points for not giving a long enough answer even if the content is correct, grades unfairly on participation regardless of circumstances and does not seem to have significant subject understanding.
